channel.title: Shaping Tomorrow Change Trackers
channel.description: Momentum scans from the Shaping Tomorrow horizon. Each Change Tracker reads across the recent evidence on one topic, labelling the signals beneath it as Accelerating, Stable or Fading, and surfacing the wild cards worth watching.

item.title: Power demand outpaces grid; US policy retreats; insured losses harden
item.description: Inaugural cycle. Clean build-out is accelerating with renewables, batteries crossing the 100 GW annual-additions mark and the first US advanced-nuclear construction permit in roughly a decade; AI-driven data-centre load and PJM price escalation strain firm capacity even as 2.6 TW sits in the interconnection queue; OBBBA's IRA rollback and the offshore-wind retreat compress US clean-energy capex into a 2026-2027 window; a sixth consecutive USD 100 bn-plus insured-loss year...

item.title: State intervention in critical minerals accelerates as the export-control truce holds
item.description: Inaugural cycle. Government intervention dominates the momentum: US strategic stockpiling, equity stakes, price floors and Section 232 trade remedies are accelerating alongside China's new supply-chain security law, while the acute 2025 export-control weapons sit paused under a US-China truce and minor-metals curbs ease.

item.title: Stablecoin rules harden as tokenised bank money scales and cash plateaus
item.category: Financial Services and the Future of Money
item.description: Inaugural cycle. United States GENIUS Act rulemaking and a maturing tokenised settlement stack lead the accelerators; the retail digital euro holds a steady multi-year tempo and the cash-displacement story has plateaued.
